The Strongest Level 0 Absolute Supremacy Through Analysis Skills

Read manga The Strongest Level 0 Absolute Supremacy Through Analysis Skills / 最強のレベル -解析スキルで完全無双- / Absolute Domination at Level 0 Using My Analysis Skill / The Strongest at Level 0 : Absolute Domination with the Analysis Skill
Mysterious “Disaster Beasts” suddenly appear on Earth and plunge humanity into an unprecedented crisis. Tenma Itsuki, whose parents were killed by these monsters, is chosen as an “Awakened,” a human granted special abilities. The job he awakens to is a supposedly impossible rare job that overturns common sense: although his level is stuck at “Level ,” he possesses a cheat‑like power that can analyze enemy skills and endlessly boost his own stats. Driven by vengeance, Tenma sets his sights on becoming the strongest human alive, and a max‑hype superpower battle story begins as he uses his analysis skill to achieve absolute domination.
